featured_reviews.name: Mehvish Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Yesterday I visited Pinka Bake House, a delightful home bakery located in Powai, Mumbai. Known as Mumbai's first cheesecake stall.

Upon my friends' enthusiastic recommendations about their cheesecakes, we decided to sample a variety: Nutella Cheesecake, Lotus Biscoff Cheesecake, Blueberry Cheesecake, and a Black Forest Mousse. The Nutella and Lotus Biscoff cheesecakes were rich and delectable, but the Blueberry Cheesecake truly stood out—it was exceptional! I'd rate the Blueberry a stellar 100/10, the Nutella an 8.5/10, the Lotus a 9/10, and the creamy Black Forest Mousse a solid 8/10.

The portions were generous, and we couldn't finish everything. The kind lady serving us graciously packed the remaining cheesecakes for us to enjoy at home. The Blueberry Cheesecake has certainly won my heart. I'm looking forward to returning for more!

featured_reviews.name: Kartikeya Pathak
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Decent Bakery Experience: Bangalore Iyangar Bakery Review

I recently ordered from Bangalore Iyangar Bakery on MG Road, Goregaon, and had their treats delivered to my home. We opted for the Mawa Cake and Marble Cake, and while they were decent, they didn't entirely blow me away.

Mawa Cake
The Mawa Cake was a classic rendition of the popular Indian dessert. The cake was moist and flavorful, with a subtle sweetness and a hint of cardamom. However, it lacked a bit of depth and richness that I've come to expect from a good Mawa Cake.

Marble Cake
The Marble Cake was a visually appealing treat, with a beautiful marbled design. The cake itself was soft and fluffy, with a subtle chocolate flavor. However, it was a bit too sweet for my taste, and the chocolate flavor could have been more pronounced.

Verdict
While the Bangalore Iyangar Bakery didn't entirely exceed my expectations, it's still a decent option for those seeking traditional Indian-style baked goods. The Mawa Cake and Marble Cake were enjoyable, if not outstanding, and the convenience of home delivery was a definite plus.

Price: Affordable (around ₹50-₹100 per cake)

Recommended for: Those seeking traditional Indian-style baked goods, casual snacks, and the convenience of home delivery.

Will I return?
Maybe, to try more of their offerings and see if they have any other hidden gems.
